references.context: Set theory: tagged disjoint union indexed by i, retaining identity of each component
Topology: a subset U of coproduct is open if and only if all intersections U∩X_i are open in X_i

references.disposition: No finiteness of the indexing family or compatibility between component topologies is assumed.

review_rationale: Reviewed disjoint-union construction and precise componentwise openness condition for a possibly indexed family of topological spaces; this is not the ordinary topology on a set-theoretic union when underlying sets overlap.
